definitions.explanation: The ability or capacity a person, team, product or place has but has not yet fully shown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ポテンシャル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: He has a lot of potential.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧ポテンシャル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This town still has untapped potential.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ポテンシャル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: Drawing out a newcomer's potential is a coach's most important job.

notes:
From English. Common in business, sports and media talk; it sounds a little more modern and upbeat than ⟦{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}→潜在能力：14972_senzainouryoku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ポテンシャル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have great potential
- ポテンシャル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧: to draw out potential
- ポテンシャル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{秘|ひ}める→秘める：13759_himeru⟧: to have hidden potential

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}→潜在能力：14972_senzainouryoku⟧: latent ability; more formal
- ⟦{伸|の}びしろ→伸びしろ：14898_nobishiro⟧: room to grow; how much better someone can still get
